title: Rafael and the Promise
author: Bram Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Almeida, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
